executive_summary: Fifteenth consecutive week of total failure with zero trades taken and zero P&L. The Supply & Demand Zone strategy is categorically dead — it has not generated actionable signals for nearly four months. No parameter tuning within this framework can fix a strategy that fundamentally cannot produce entries in real market conditions. The bot requires a complete architectural overhaul: either replace the core strategy entirely or add parallel strategies that can actually generate signals across all regime types.
target_progress: 0% — 70% below the 70% target. No trades means no progress is possible.
regime_assessment: Regime detection appears to be working correctly — 6 days of trending_down and 1 day of trending_up seems plausible for October market conditions. However, regime detection is irrelevant when the strategy generates zero signals in ANY regime. The strategy failed in both trending_down (6 days) and trending_up (1 day), proving regime is not the bottleneck — the signal generation engine itself is broken.

symbol_changes.remove_reason: No symbol data exists because no trades were taken. Symbol selection cannot be evaluated.
symbol_changes.focus_reason: Cannot determine focus symbols without any trade history. The priority is getting ANY signals first.

dow_pattern: No day-of-week pattern can be identified — zero trades across all days for 15 consecutive weeks. Day-of-week optimization is meaningless until the bot can actually trade.

param_search_adjustments.reasoning: After 15 weeks of zero signals, the current min_score of 75 and RR of 2.0 are clearly too restrictive. However, this is a band-aid — even aggressive parameter loosening has been recommended for months with no effect. The real problem is structural. These ranges are provided only as a last-resort fallback if the structural changes below are not implemented.

structural_recommendations.change: ABANDON Supply & Demand Zones as the sole strategy. Implement a multi-strategy engine with at least 2-3 parallel strategies: (1) EMA crossover / trend-following for trending regimes, (2) VWAP mean-reversion for ranging regimes, (3) Opening Range Breakout for high-volatility sessions. Each strategy should independently generate signals.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Move from 0 trades/week to 15-30 trades/week. Even at a 45% win rate, this produces data to iterate on — which is infinitely more valuable than zero trades at a theoretical 66.7% win rate.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement a 'signal generation health check' — if the bot goes 2 consecutive trading days with zero signals, automatically reduce min_score by 10 points, widen zone tolerances by 20%, and reduce RR ratio by 0.3. Continue loosening every 2 days until signals appear. This prevents the 15-week dead zone we are currently in.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Eliminates multi-week zero-trade streaks entirely. Guarantees at least some signals within any given week, even if quality is lower.

structural_recommendations.change: Add a simple momentum/breakout strategy as an immediate parallel signal source. Use 20-period high breakouts with ATR-based stops. This requires minimal development and works in trending_down (short) and trending_up (long) regimes.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Could generate 5-10 signals per day in trending markets, which represent 6 of 7 days this week. Even conservative filtering should yield 2-5 trades per week.

structural_recommendations.change: Implement comprehensive signal pipeline logging — log every candidate zone found, every score calculated, and every reason a potential trade was rejected. Without this diagnostic data, we are blind to WHY zero signals are produced.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Enables root cause analysis within 1 week instead of continuing to guess. May reveal a single filter or threshold that is killing all candidates.

structural_recommendations.change: If Supply & Demand Zones must be retained, fundamentally rebuild zone detection: increase lookback from 18 to 60 days, allow up to 8 base candles, accept zone retests (not just fresh zones), and score zones on a 0-100 scale with a passing threshold of 40.
structural_recommendations.expected_impact: Could increase zone detection rate by 5-10x, potentially yielding 3-8 candidates per day for filtering.

primary_strategy_next_week: Multi-Strategy Engine (EMA Crossover + Breakout + Supply & Demand Zones as fallback)
